## Runs 6–7 — SdH spot checks (`sdh-spot-check`), D = 0, electron n = +3.2×10¹² and hole n = −1.2×10¹²

**Read — electron (run 6).** Strong SdH, **onset ≤ 1.0 T**. That figure comes from the 10 mT segment and is censored at its low edge. Run 6 below 1 T was stepped at 50 mT, which undersamples a 7 T tone below about 0.86 T, so its apparent 0.3 T "onset" is not trusted. Peak set: **7.3–7.4 T** (dominant, persists to 1 T), **22.2 T** (onset 1.4 T), **29.5 T** (onset 1.8 T), plus 14.8 T and a high-order comb. F_L = 33.1 T. Against the model (ABAB 7.31 / 25.78 T; ABCA 33.1 T), the 7.4 T tone sits on the ABAB light branch at scale ≈ 1.0. No tone appears at 25.8 T or at 33.1 T. The single trace underdetermines what the rest are:
- 22.2 and 29.5 T are ≈ 3× and 4× of 7.4 T. That reading says "harmonic comb" and would leave the Luttinger sum unexplained.
- They are also a pair {7.4, 22.2} with its **sum** tone 29.6 ≈ 0.89·F_L. That reading is ABAB plus the symmetry-allowed breakdown/mixing tone, with the scale off by 11%.
- Or 29.5 T is an F_L singleton at scale 0.89 plus something else.

The investigation flags exactly this trap: the ABAB heavy/light ratio (3.5 here) drifts through 3×, and a ratio-only screen eats the real heavy tone. **The discriminator is n-dependence**, which the fan provides. Each harmonic tracks k·f₁(n); the heavy branch tracks its own Onsager curve (model dF/dn ≈ 7.2 T per 10¹²); an F_L tone tracks 10.3 T per 10¹².

**Read — hole (run 7).** Also strong. Onset 0.71 T (6.6 T tone). The trace nearly reaches Rxx ≈ 0 minima by 2 T. Peaks: ≈ 7.0 T dominant, a 12.3 T tone (≈ F_L = 12.4 T), and harmonics. At −1.2×10¹² this is the recipe's near-CNP exception regime: the ABAB hole pair (5.9 / 6.5 T) is close and balanced, so the pair cannot be told apart from one tone plus a sum tone on this record. It is a preview only; the D = 0 line cannot go past −1.27×10¹² on the hole side (TG limit).

**Take:** the fan goes on the **electron side**. It is the only side that reaches the discriminating density range |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹². It inherits Δ(1/B) = 0.01 T⁻¹ (run 6's low-field step), onset 1.0 T, sensitivity 50 µV and τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB. No stacking call yet.

# Runs 6-7 — sdh-spot-check (electron n=+3.2e12, hole n=-1.2e12; D = 0, run-5 cal). Raw first, then onset + FFT vs model.
import sys, warnings
from hera.analysis import resolve_channels, sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.home() / "measurement_env" / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"))
import fs_count_b0 as FSM

SPOT = {6: +3.2, 7: -1.2}                       # 1e12 cm^-2, D = 0
fig, ax = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(13, 8))
for j, rid in enumerate((6, 7)):
    r = run(rid); ch = {c.cid: c for c in resolve_channels(r.meta)}
    B = r.col("magnet_field"); I = r.col("sr0_X") / ch["sr0"].gain
    R = (r.col("sr1_X") / ch["sr1"].gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B); B, R = B[o], R[o]
    n = SPOT[rid]; FL = float(luttinger_frequency(n * 1e16))
    abab = [F for F, _ in FSM.abab_fs(n * 1e16)[1]]; Fa, ma = FSM.abca_mstar(n * 1e16)
    print(f"run {rid}: n = {n:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.2f} T | model ABAB {', '.join(f'{F:.2f}' for F in abab)} T | ABCA {Fa:.2f} T (m* {ma:.3f}) | "
          f"R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm, T {r.col('T_sample').min():.3f}-{r.col('T_sample').max():.3f} K, I_tg max {np.abs(r.col('k_2400_tg_curr')).max()*1e12:.0f} pA")
    ax[0, j].plot(B, R, lw=0.7); ax[0, j].set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax[0, j].set_ylabel("Rxx B_1-B_2 (Ohm)")
    ax[0, j].set_title(f"run {rid} raw — n = {n:+.1f}e12, D = 0")
    # run 6 below 1 T is 50 mT-stepped: undersampled for a 7 T tone below ~0.86 T -> onset on the 10 mT segment only
    m = B >= (0.995 if rid == 6 else 0.29)
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        on = sdh_onset(R[m], B[m], b_lo=float(B[m].min()), r_full_scale=50e-6 / np.median(np.abs(I)))
    print(on.summary())
    for ww in w: print("  warn:", str(ww.message)[:160])
    ax[0, j].axvline(on.onset_b, color="r", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"onset_b {on.onset_b:.2f} T"); ax[0, j].legend()
    for lo in (on.onset_b, 1.3 * on.onset_b):
        fq, sp = sdh_fft(R[m][:, None], B[m], b_range=(lo, B.max()), bg_degree=5, nfft=4096)
        s = sp[0]; k = fq > 2; s = s / s[k].max()
        pk, _ = find_peaks(np.where(k, s, 0), prominence=0.08)
        print(f"  FFT [{lo:.2f}, {B.max():.1f}] T peaks: " + ", ".join(f"{fq[p]:.1f}({s[p]:.2f})" for p in pk[:8]))
        ax[1, j].plot(fq[k], s[k], lw=0.8, label=f"window [{lo:.2f}, {B.max():.0f}] T")
    ax[1, j].axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", label=f"F_L {FL:.1f} T")
    for F in abab:
        if F > 1: ax[1, j].axvline(F, color="b", ls=":", lw=1.2)
    ax[1, j].plot([], [], "b:", label="ABAB model"); ax[1, j].set_xlim(0, 2.2 * FL)
    ax[1, j].set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax[1, j].set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm.)"); ax[1, j].legend(fontsize=7)
fig.suptitle("vti-02 SdH spot checks (runs 6, 7): raw Rxx(B) and 1/B FFT (bg deg 5 in B) vs F_L and the ABAB model")
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`, `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4)

> **05:27** · landau-fan-vti: e-side D=0, n +1.75..+3.24e12 (37) x B 1.0->10 T uniform 1/B (91 rows, d(1/B)=0.01), sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast 2.1 s; ends 10 T · **ETA ~09:12** (≈3h45m)

**Why this fan.** Spot check run 6 (electron side, n = +3.2×10¹², ana cells 14–15) shows strong SdH with onset ≤ 1.0 T and tones at 7.4, 22.2 and 29.5 T; F_L is 33.1 T. The 7.4 T tone sits on the ABAB light branch at scale ≈ 1. On one trace, though, {22.2, 29.5} can't be told apart between two readings: 3×/4× harmonics of 7.4 T, or an ABAB heavy tone plus its sum/breakdown tone. The investigation names this trap (the ABAB ratio drifts through 3×). The **fan's per-column F(n)** is what discriminates:
- a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n);
- the ABAB heavy branch tracks its own Onsager curve (≈ 7.2 T per 10¹²);
- an F_L singleton tracks 10.3 T per 10¹²;
- the partition f₁ + f₂ = F_L(n) either holds across density or it doesn't.

The fan goes on the electron side because the hole side of the D = 0 line stops at −1.27×10¹² (TG limit). That is the near-CNP exception regime, where run 7's pair is not separable.

**Design (floored per `landau-fan` step 1).** Fast axis: a paired n-line at D = 0 (run-5 cal), **n = +1.75 → +3.24×10¹², 37 points**. It ends at n_hi, 5 mV under the TG limit, and includes the spot-check density.

- *B axis:* **1.0 → 10.0 T, uniform in 1/B, 91 rows**. Δ(1/B) = 0.01 T⁻¹ is inherited from run 6, giving Nyquist 50 T against F_L(n_hi) = 33.5 T (1.5× margin, 3 samples per F_L period).
- *B_lo:* **1.0 T** = `sdh_onset().onset_b` on run 6's 10 mT segment. It is censored there, so it is a lower bound. The heavy tone's onset is 1.4 T and the 29.5 T tone's is 1.8 T.
- *n axis:* ray period at 1 T is 0.097×10¹², so Δn = 0.041 gives 2.3 points per period. That stays ≥ 2 even with a +15% lever-arm scale error.
- *Lock-in:* sensitivity **50 µV** (5 kΩ FS), inherited. Worst corner is n = 1.75 at 10 T, estimated 0.8–1.2 kΩ (R₀ = 80 Ω from run 5, times run 6's ×10 MR), i.e. ≤ 25% FS. τ = 0.3 s / 24 dB, read and asserted, not set. fast_delay 2.1 s = 7τ (rig-card settling floor for 24 dB).
- *Resolution:* δF = 1.1 T. Heavy vs F_L separation runs from 2.8 T at n = 1.75 to 7.4 T at n = 3.24.

**Coverage trade, stated.**
- **Excluded:** the hole side (unreachable at discriminating |n|); n < 1.75 (light tone under 2.5 periods, heavy within ~2 T of F_L, nothing to discriminate); n > 3.25 (TG limit).
- **Light tone:** it gets ≥ 5 periods only for n ≳ 2.65, and 2.5–5 periods over 1.75–2.65. There the fan reads mainly the heavy/F_L trajectories, and the partition sum is claimed for n ≳ 2.3.
- **Not bought:** buying 5 light periods at n = 2.0 would need B_lo ≈ 0.66 T. That costs +56 rows and +11 columns, about +80% (+2h45m), and the light tone's onset below 1 T is unmeasured (run 6 below 1 T was undersampled).

**Price.**
- grid: 3367 pts × 2.22 s = 125 min
- magnet traverse 1 → 10 T: 66 min
- positioning 0 → 1 T: 7 min
- row overhead: 91 × ~8 s = 12 min
- total: **≈ 3.5 h modeled**; ETA priced 5–10% over.

Endpoint: **field stays at 10 T** so the next step (the LK mass split) rides down from there. Gates stay at n = +3.24, D = 0.

**Guards (E1, auto-abort):** gate current > 1 nA; T_sample > 2.0 K; thermometry logfile stale at any row start; more than 10 points with sr1 above 90% FS. Preconditions asserted: T at base, B ≈ 0, V_si = 0, PS/output on, nplci 1, τ/slope/drive as priced.

**Checkpoints (via `hera-watch`):**
1. **First rows** (+9–12 min, B = 1.00–1.02 T): Rxx scale ~60–100 Ω, sr1 fs, drain current ≈ 9.9 nA, gate currents at their pA offsets, T.
2. **Row ~30** (+55 min, B ≈ 1.4 T): re-form the partial fan and look for rays. Abandon if there is no oscillatory structure, which would contradict run 6.
3. **Row 50** (+1h30m, B = 2 T): partial per-column FFT over 1–2 T. Does the light tone track across n?
4. **Completion:** full per-column FFT, model overlay and Luttinger check in ana.

# === Step 4 — Landau fan for the stacking call (`landau-fan-vti`; tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4) ===
# Electron side, D = 0 (run-5 cal): n = +1.75 -> +3.24e12 (37 pts, ascending) x B = 1.0 -> 10.0 T uniform in 1/B
# (91 rows, d(1/B) = 0.01 1/T, inherited from spot check run 6). Per-column SdH FFT fan.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration: ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_LO, N_HI, N_N, D0 = 1.75, 3.24, 37, 0.0          # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm
ns = np.linspace(N_LO, N_HI, N_N)                 # ascending: the fan ends at n_hi (the spot-check density)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, D0 * np.ones_like(ns), CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs, Vbgs)
_nchk, _Dchk = calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert np.allclose(_nchk, ns) and np.allclose(_Dchk, D0, atol=1e-9)
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 1.0, 10.0, 91
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)               # ascending, uniform in 1/B
assert B_vec.min() > 0 and B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and abs(np.diff(1 / B_vec).mean() + 0.01) < 1e-9
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.3f}..{ns[-1]:+.3f}e12 ({N_N} pts, dn {ns[1]-ns[0]:.4f}); Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f}..{Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T, {N_B} rows uniform in 1/B (d(1/B) = 0.0100 1/T -> Nyquist 50 T vs F_L(n_hi) = 33.5 T)")

# --- preconditions (state this cell assumes but does not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5) | B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: fan starts from 0 -> 1 T) | V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0) | "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()} | nplci {k_tg.nplci()}/{k_bg.nplci()} (1/1) | "
      f"sr1 tau {_tau} s, slope {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24: the dwell is priced on it) | drive {sr1.amplitude()} V @ {sr1.frequency()} Hz")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5, f"T_sample {_T0} K off base"
assert abs(_B0) < 0.05, f"magnet not at ~0 T: {_B0}"
assert abs(k_si()) < 0.01, "Si gate not at 0"
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1
assert _tau == 0.3 and _slope == 24, "lock-in settling changed from the priced 0.3 s / 24 dB"
assert abs(sr1.amplitude() - 1.0) < 1e-6 and abs(sr1.frequency() - 13.777) < 0.01, "drive changed from 1 V / 13.777 Hz"

# --- lock-in: fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (inherited from runs 6/7): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA.
# Worst corner low-n x 10 T: R0(n=1.75) ~ 80 Ohm (run 5) x MR ~10 (run 6: 53 -> 530 Ohm) ~ 0.8-1.2 kOhm = 16-24 % FS.
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
SENS = sr1.sensitivity()
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 2.1, 3.0                 # 7 tau at 24 dB/oct (settling floor, rig card); row start 3 s + flyback
I_TRIP, T_TRIP, CLIP_MAX = 1e-9, 2.0, 10
print(f"sr1 sens {SENS} V (5 kOhm FS), sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V; fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti (tetralayer-stacking-fs-count step 4): electron side D = 0, n {N_LO:+.2f} -> {N_HI:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}), "
                  f"B {B_LO} -> {B_HI} T uniform 1/B ({N_B}, d(1/B)=0.01), sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s/24 dB, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'tetralayer-stacking-fs-count step 4 | D = {D0} V/nm, n = {N_LO} to {N_HI} e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts, ascending), '
              f'B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform in 1/B ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) = 0.01 1/T); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, '
              f'c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; onset 1.0 T (run 6, censored lower bound); '
              f'sr1 50 uV, tau 0.3 s 24 dB, fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s')

# --- position: gates to the first n-point, then the magnet 0 -> 1 T (blocking, ~7.3 min at 0.137 T/min).
# NB: interrupting during the ramp does not stop the supply (rig card) — it completes to 1 T.
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
print(f"ramping magnet {magnet.field():+.3f} -> {B_vec[0]:.3f} T ...")
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T = {T_sample():.3f} K")

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_2400_tg_volt, k_2400_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.P)
s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.X); s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr0.P)
s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr); s.plot('time', T_sample)

_g = {"pt": 0, "clip": 0}
def fan_guard(station, data):
    _g["pt"] += 1
    i_tg, i_bg, T, x1 = abs(float(data[5])), abs(float(data[6])), float(data[4]), abs(float(data[9]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f}, Vbg={float(data[3]):+.4f}: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if T > T_TRIP:
        print(f"T TRIP: T_sample = {T:.3f} K > {T_TRIP} K at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
    if x1 > 0.9 * SENS:
        _g["clip"] += 1
        if _g["clip"] == 1 or _g["clip"] > CLIP_MAX:
            print(f"CLIP: |sr1.X| = {x1:.3e} V > 0.9 x {SENS} at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T, Vtg={float(data[2]):+.4f} (count {_g['clip']})")
        if _g["clip"] > CLIP_MAX:
            station.interrupt_requested = True
    if _g["pt"] % N_N == 1:                        # row start: thermometry freshness (>= 2-3 write periods)
        try:
            assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"THERMOMETRY STALE at B={float(data[1]):.3f} T: {e}")
            station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(fan_guard, ())

s.multimegasweep([magnet.field], [B_vec], [k_tg.volt, k_bg.volt], [Vtgs, Vbgs],
                 slow_delay=SLOW_DELAY, fast_delay=FAST_DELAY)
